cat <<'PYEOF' | sudo tee /opt/inventory-api/app.py >/dev/null
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

START = time.time()
INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
]

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, obj, code=200):
        body = json.dumps(obj).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json({"status": "ok", "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1), "pid": __import__("os").getpid()})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json({"items": INVENTORY})
        else:
            self._json({"error": "not found"}, 404)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
